**8B.2 Research Note**

Bottom line: **yes, substantially, but unevenly**. In 2024 Abiy’s program was translated into concrete economic reform packages, institutional redesigns, appointments, timelines, and enforcement tools. The clearest execution evidence is in macro reform, central-bank restructuring, social protection, and transitional-justice planning. The main negative counterevidence is that the same government also operationalized coercive emergency rule, secret security structures, and information controls.

**Accepted Claims**

- **Ethiopia Embarking on Full Implementation of Macroeconomic Reform Policy** | **ENA English** | **2024-07-28** | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4869646 | Abiy said Ethiopia had entered full implementation of macroeconomic reform to address debt burden, inflation, unemployment, and low productivity. This is direct evidence of a program being translated into a concrete implementation phase. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 8B.1, 7B.9

- **The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia: Request of an Arrangement Under the Extended Credit Facility-Press Release; Staff Report; and Statement by the Executive Director for The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia** | **International Monetary Fund** | **2024-07-29** | https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2024/07/29/the-federal-democratic-republic-of-ethiopia-request-of-an-arrangement-under-the-extended-552778 | The IMF package converted the reform agenda into explicit benchmarks, policy actions, governance measures, and sequencing around exchange rate, inflation, debt sustainability, and SOE oversight. This is among the strongest pieces of evidence that Abiy’s program was operationalized through measurable targets and institutions. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 8B.1, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **IMF Completes Ethiopia’s First Review Under ECF Arrangement** | **International Monetary Fund** | **2024-10-18** | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/10/18/pr-24383-ethiopia-imf-completes-the-1st-review-under-the-ecf-arrangement | Ethiopia met all quantitative performance criteria and most structural benchmarks. This shows formal follow-through on the program, not just announcement. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **Council of Ministers approved draft NBE proclamation and banking business proclamation** | **National Bank of Ethiopia** | **2024-06-14** | https://nbe.gov.et/nbe_news/the-council-of-ministers-today-approved-the-draft-nbe-proclamation-and-banking-business-proclamation/ | The government moved to harden central-bank and banking governance through legislation framed around credibility, accountability, transparency, and governance. This is concrete institutional translation of the reform program. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **National Bank of Ethiopia announces the launch of a new monetary policy framework** | **National Bank of Ethiopia** | **2024-07-09** | https://nbe.gov.et/nbe_news/the-national-bank-of-ethiopia-announces-the-launch-of-a-new-monetary-policy-framework/ | The central bank said it had enhanced technical capacity and moved to a price-stability framework with market-oriented tools. That is an institutional and operational mechanism, not just rhetoric. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **World Bank backs Ethiopia’s reforms to promote sustainable and inclusive growth** | **World Bank** | **2024-07-30** | https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/07/30/world-bank-backs-ethiopia-s-reforms-to-promote-sustainable-and-inclusive-afe-growth | The reform package explicitly aimed to expand social safety nets, improve public-spending effectiveness, and protect poor and vulnerable households. This shows the program was tied to budgetary priorities and distributional choices. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **Ethiopia signs 17.2 billion USD financing agreements with the World Bank** | **Ministry of Finance, Ethiopia** | **2024-04-05** | https://www.mofed.gov.et/blog/ethiopia-signs-172-billion-usd-financing-agreements-with-the-world-bank/ | The government directed funds to rural connectivity, food security, adaptive safety nets, power-sector reform, and water/sanitation. This is concrete allocation evidence, not just general promises. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **Energizing AFE Ethiopia: New World Bank Program Expands Access to Electricity** | **World Bank** | **2024-04-03** | https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2024/04/03/energizing-afe-ethiopia-new-world-bank-program-expands-access-to-electricity | The power-sector reform program aimed to expand the grid, improve utility viability, and mobilize private-sector participation. This is a concrete sector plan with implementation hooks. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **The Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia Public Sector Capacity Building project** | **World Bank** | **2024-08-16** | https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099082124120033234 | The project objective was to improve government capacity to mobilize and manage public financial and human resources, including public administration, HR, finance, procurement, and core systems. This is a direct capacity-building mechanism tied to the broader program. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **Ethiopia to Pursue Transitional Justice Through Independent Justice Process** | **ENA English** | **2024-06-13** | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_4596260 | The government set out a transitional-justice process with truth, reconciliation, amnesty, reparations, and institutional reform. That is a concrete institutional roadmap with stated process commitments. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 8B.1, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.10

- **Ethiopian Justice Minister Briefs Diplomats about Transitional Justice Policy Implementation** | **ENA English** | **2024-12-14** | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/eng_5626876 | The minister said legal frameworks and implementation roadmaps would create independent and impartial institutions for transitional justice. This is evidence of institution-building and timeline-setting, albeit still mostly roadmap-level. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.10

- **Ethiopias leader plays down fears of conflict with Somalia over a planned naval port** | **Associated Press via CityNews** | **2024-02-06** | https://kitchener.citynews.ca/2024/02/06/ethiopias-leader-plays-down-fears-of-conflict-with-somalia-over-a-planned-naval-port/ | Abiy publicly said he had no intention of going to war with Somalia and framed the issue as mutual benefit. This is a concrete foreign-policy commitment that can be checked against later action. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 8B.1, 7B.8, 7B.10

- **Landlocked Ethiopia signs pact to use Somaliland’s Red Sea port** | **Reuters** | **2024-01-01** | https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Landlocked-Ethiopia-signs-pact-to-use-Somaliland-s-Red-Sea-port-45654814/ | The Berbera MOU tied access to naval use, recognition, and stakes in state-run companies. This shows the program included a concrete but destabilizing geopolitical bargain, not just abstract rhetoric. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 8B.1, 7B.8, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **Details of State of Emergency Declared by Gov't of Ethiopia** | **ENA English** | **2024-11-03** | https://www.ena.et/web/eng/w/en_30124 | The proclamation centralized coercive authority under an operation command, restricted CSOs and media, and suspended normal judicial handling of enforcement. This is a concrete enforcement mechanism for regime control, showing that the program was operationalized through coercion as well as reform. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.7, 7B.8, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **In Ethiopia, a secret committee orders killings and arrests to crush rebels** | **Ethiopian Human Rights Commission / Reuters** | **2024-02-27** | https://ehrc.org/in-ethiopia-a-secret-committee-orders-killings-and-arrests-to-crush-rebels-reuters/ | The EHRC head confirmed a secret Koree Nageenyaa committee that interfered in the justice system. This is evidence of a hidden enforcement architecture running alongside formal institutions. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **Ethiopia: Freedom on the Net 2024** | **Freedom House** | **2024** | https://freedomhouse.org/country/ethiopia/freedom-net/2024 | The government used internet restrictions, social-media restrictions, and journalist detentions under emergency powers. This shows the program was enforced partly through information control, not only through formal policy design. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.6, 7B.7, 7B.9, 7B.10

- **Ethiopia: Freedom on the Net 2024** | **Freedom House** | **2024** | https://freedomhouse.org/country/ethiopia/freedom-net/2024 | Freedom House also reported online manipulation and propaganda tactics, which is evidence that the government used communication controls as a governing mechanism. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.10, 7B.9

- **Ethiopia: Freedom on the Net 2024** | **Freedom House** | **2024** | https://freedomhouse.org/country/ethiopia/freedom-net/2024 | The Amhara blackout eventually ended, with shutdown restrictions restored in some cities by mid-July. This is weak evidence of partial implementation reversal, not a full strategy, but it is a concrete operational change. | **QIDs:** 8B.2, 7B.10

**Search Gap**

- I found **strong evidence of implementation in macroeconomic reform, banking/central-bank rules, social spending, transitional justice, and emergency enforcement**.
- I did **not** find a single published master implementation plan with complete line-item budgets, timelines, and institutional responsibilities across all policy pillars.
- Several positive items are **official statements or multilateral assessments**, so they prove concrete institutionalization more than final outcomes.
- The negative side is also important: Abiy’s program was translated into **coercive enforcement mechanisms** and **information controls** as well as reform structures.
